description: This file defines a class for testing internal facets in an Orleans grain, including state management and grain interface implementation.

classes.name: MultifacetFactoryTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class implementing testing methods for multifacet reading and writing, with state management.

classes.name: MultifacetFactoryTestGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state of the grain, holding references to reader and writer interfaces.

methods.name: GetReader
methods.description: Returns the reader interface, either from input or from the grain's state.

methods.name: GetWriter
methods.description: Returns the writer interface, either from input or from the grain's state.

methods.name: SetReader
methods.description: Sets the reader interface in the grain's state.

methods.name: SetWriter
methods.description: Sets the writer interface in the grain's state.
